disclaimer.title: Estimates only
disclaimer.body: Max heart rate from age is an estimate. Measured max heart rate or lab testing is more accurate. This tool is for general fitness planning, not medical diagnosis.

method.title: How this works
method.description: The calculator uses well-known formulas used in fitness coaching.

points.karvonen: Karvonen: target BPM = resting HR + (fraction of heart rate reserve). Heart rate reserve = estimated max HR minus resting HR.
points.maxHr: Estimated max HR = 220 minus age (common rule of thumb).
points.zones: Zones use 10% steps of heart rate reserve from 50% through 100%.

footer.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional before starting or changing an exercise program.
